run_train_and_evaluate: run the nanodo training pipeline with a config file path for language modelling
run_main_cli: run the nanodo main CLI entry point with absl flags and JAX configuration
define_config_flags: define a locked config flag for training hyperparameters using ml_collections
log_jax_process_info: log JAX process index, process count, and local devices information
set_task_status: set the CLU work unit task status with JAX process index and process count
